abuse-address.description: Postal address of the abuse contact for the network the IP address belongs to

abuse-email.description: Email address of the abuse contact

abuse-phone.description: Phone number of the abuse contact

asn-abuser-score.description: Abuser score of the autonomous system announcing the IP address, over all its IPv4 routes: the share of its addresses seen in abuse, followed by a label from Very Low to Very High, such as 0.0327 (High)

company-abuser-score.description: Abuser score of the network the IP address is registered in: the share of its addresses seen in abuse, followed by a label from Very Low to Very High, such as 0.3086 (Very High)

company-domain.description: Domain of the organisation the IP address is registered to

company-name.description: Name of the organisation the IP address is registered to, from WHOIS

company-type.description: Type of the organisation the IP address is registered to: hosting, isp, education, government, banking or business

crawler.description: Name of the crawler or bot operating from the IP address, such as GoogleBot

datacenter.description: Name of the hosting, cloud or CDN provider the IP address belongs to

ip.description: IP address the information refers to

is-abuser.description: The IP address was recently seen in abuse (attacks, spam, scanning) by blocklists or honeypots

is-anycast.description: The IP address is anycast: it is announced from many sites and answers from the nearest one

is-crawler.description: The IP address is used by a crawler or bot, such as a search engine, SEO or AI crawler or an uptime monitor

is-datacenter.description: The IP address belongs to a hosting, cloud or CDN provider

is-mobile.description: The IP address belongs to a mobile carrier

is-proxy.description: The IP address is a known open proxy (HTTP, SOCKS4, SOCKS5)

is-satellite.description: The IP address belongs to a satellite ISP, such as Starlink or Viasat

is-tor.description: The IP address is a Tor exit node

is-vpn.description: The IP address is a VPN exit node or server

rir.description: Registry the WHOIS record of the IP address comes from, such as RIPE, ARIN or JPNIC

vpn-last-seen.description: Last time the IP address was seen as a VPN exit node or server

vpn-service.description: Name of the VPN provider; several providers sharing a range are joined with +

vpn-type.description: exit_node when VPN traffic was seen leaving from the IP address, vpn_server when the VPN provider lists it as one of its servers

description: IP address intelligence from ipapi.is: VPN (with the provider), proxy, Tor, datacenter, abuser, crawler, mobile, satellite and anycast detection, the organisation the address is registered to with its abuser score, and the abuse contact.
name: ipapi-is-ip
